buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 1 year before the bid opening date. Copies of relevant contracts to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the year. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 6. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the

bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Text Based ATC Clauses 1. Tender Details The tender is invited for procurement of Radiation Monitoring Equipment against Indent/Case No. 25WQBC025. 2. Compliance Statement Bidders are required to submit a para-wise compliance statement to the terms, conditions, an d technical specifications of the bid document. Any deviation from the stipulated terms, condi tions and/or technical specifications shall be clearly indicated during bid submission. 3. Bid Mode and Inspection The bid is being floated on Limited Tender Enquiry (LTE) basis under Single-Bid System. The items shall be subjected to inspection by DQA(N) against approved Quality Assurance Plan (QAP). Only the IHQ/NHQ-nominated LTE vendors listed below are eligible to participate in the subject bid: 1. M/s Nucleonix Systems Pvt. Ltd., Hyderabad. 2. M/s PLA Electro Appliance Pvt. Ltd., Pune. 3. M/s Electronics Corporation of India Ltd. (ECIL), Hyderabad. 4. M/s Indesys Equipment Pvt. Ltd., Pune. Bids submitted by any firm other than the above-mentioned IHQ/NHQ-nominated vendors shall be liable for rejection during technical evaluation. 4. Bid Security Declaration / EMD Bidders are required to submit EMD or Bid Security Declaration, as applicable under extant Go vernment rules/provisions. The Bid Security Declaration, wherever applicable, shall state that if the bidder withdraws or modifies its bid during the period of bid validity, or if awarded the contract and fails to sign th e contract or submit the required Performance Security within the prescribed period, the bidd er shall be liable for suspension/debarment for the period specified in the bidding documents from participating in future procurements of the procuring entity. 5. Acceptance of Additional Terms and Conditions

The bidder shall upload scanned copies of the bid documents duly signed and stamped by the authorized signatory as a token of acceptance of the additional terms and conditions. Failure to upload the duly signed and stamped documents may render the bid liable for rejecti on. 6. Acceptance of Technical Specifications The bidder shall upload scanned copies of the technical specifications/technical documents dul y signed and stamped by the authorized signatory as a token of acceptance of the specificatio ns stipulated in the bid document. 7. Delivery Period The delivery period shall be 90 days from the date of placement of Purchase Order (PO). 8. Past Experience Prior experience in supplying the tendered items is mandatory for qualification in the bid. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of past experience, as stipulated in the bid document/MQR. 9. E-Invoicing and Payment 9.1 E-Invoices shall be generated by the vendor using the applicable GSTIN of the procuring e ntity, as indicated in the GeM bid/contract documents. 9.2 Payment shall be processed subject to submission of a valid E-Invoice, along with the bill a nd all other requisite supporting documents, as per applicable rules and contractual provision s. 10. Quality Assurance and Inspection The supplied items shall conform strictly to the tendered technical specifications and the appr oved QAP. Inspection shall be carried out by DQA(N) as per the approved QAP. The supplier shall provide all necessary facilities, documents and assistance required for inspection and acceptance of th e stores. 11. GeM Bid The subject procurement pertains to the GeM Bid against the concerned Indent/Case No. 25WQBC025. All bidders are required to comply with the terms and conditions stipulated in th e GeM bid and associated bidding documents. 12. Bid-Related Queries For any clarification or queries related to the bid, firms may contact: Controller of Procurement (N-2 Section) Material Organization Naval Base Karwar, Karnataka – 581308 E-mail: dcpro1-karwar@navy.gov.in Telephone: 08382-233599 / 3677 / 3525 .
